title: Amazon cut about 250 jobs from its devices team just weeks after launching a bunch of new devices.
description:
In the last 30 days Amazon has launched new tablets, a new Kindle, a picture frame, and multiple new Echo devices. Now the company is cutting around 250 positions from its devices and services team, though Reuters says they’re primarily focused on software development. Amazon did not confirm a reason for the layoffs, but developers are facing increased pressure from increasingly advanced AI coding tools.

title: What is the difference between buyout & layoff as Microsoft offers buyout to 60,000 employees across India, US, UK & Canada?
description: Microsoft buyout offer to 60,000 workers: Microsoft has introduced a Voluntary Exit Offer (VEO) for eligible employees in India, the US, Canada and the UK, with reports suggesting around 60,000 workers could qualify. The programme allows employees to leave voluntarily with financial support, unlike layoffs, where the company decides to cut jobs. The move comes as Microsoft ramps up AI investments while managing workforce costs.

title: Zoho Skips 2026 Salary Hikes As AI Costs Surge; Sridhar Vembu Says Outlook For Software Jobs Is ‘Grim’
description: Zoho has cancelled its annual salary hike for employees in 2026, with co-founder Sridhar Vembu citing a four-fold rise in data-centre server prices and higher AI usage. The company has also cut marketing spending and has not increased its employee count for 18 months. Vembu said Zoho will work to avoid mass layoffs but called software jobs outlook “grim”.
